title: POST /api/projects/:id/parking-lot/:pid/promote — promote to milestone or todo
description: Promote a parking lot item into an actual milestone or todo, then archive the original item.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
Creates a milestone or todo from the parking lot item's title + description
Archives the parking lot item after promotion

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Find parking lot item. 3) Validate { targetType: z.enum(['milestone','todo']) }. 4) If 'milestone': insert into milestones with name = item.title, description = item.description, sort_order = max+1. If 'todo': insert into todos with title = item.title. 5) Set item.archived_at = NOW(). 6) Return 200 { created: newRecord }.
Promote parking lot item to milestone — verify milestone created, item archived. Promote another to todo — verify todo created.
